text: 反向伝播packetの特性線参照 Counterpropagating packet characteristic reference 反向伝播packetの特性線参照 Iplus(x,y,t)=6G(x-t,y;.25); Iminus(x,y,t)=6G(x+t,y;.75); E=Gplus+Gminus,Fx=Gplus-Gminus,Fy=0; Pxx=E,Pyy=Pzz=0. 2D空間に3D角度測度を用い、c=1の軸に整列した光線を扱います。実際の符号付き角度輸送と非線形の閉じたM1方程式をともに進めます。解析特性線の参照はRTE/S_Nに適用し、M1解全体の厳密参照とはしません。 Counterpropagating packet characteristic reference Iplus(x,y,t)=6G(x-t,y;.25); Iminus(x,y,t)=6G(x+t,y;.75); E=Gplus+Gminus,Fx=Gplus-Gminus,Fy=0; Pxx=E,Pyy=Pzz=0. 2Dspace with3Dangular measure,c1. Pure aligned rays; actual signed-angle transport and nonlinear closed M1 both evolved. The analytic characteristic reference applies to RTE/S_N,not to the entire M1 solution. opposing-beams2d 反向伝播packetの特性線参照 Counterpropagating packet characteristic reference 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
